svg.title: What Omniscient fills on its own and what waits for you
svg.desc: How Omniscient's agent Otto writes to records. Fills on its own: new people and companies by your sync settings, each email and meeting on the right record, call notes and facts with their quotes, company details from the company's own website when empty, amount and close date when empty and Otto is at least 85% sure, and fields set to Fill when empty on the same terms. Waits for you to accept or skip: every change of stage, a value that would replace one already there, a value Otto is less than 85% sure of, and a field value read from a private inbox. Left alone or dropped: a field a person typed stays as it is, and a field rule value under 60% sure or with no quote is dropped.
svg.text: Some values fill in, the rest wait for you
